title: adaptive_sf.py: Congestion SF not forced to 12 as spec requires
description: Lines 142-145: When utilization > 200, spec pseudocode says 'return 12, false' (constant 12). Implementation returns 'sf, False' where sf may be less than 12. Example: if sf=8 initially and utilization=210, spec returns (12, false) but code returns (11, False) after increments. The OR-merge of conditions causes sf to only increment rather than being forced to the congestion ceiling.
close_reason: Fixed: Separated the OR-merged conditions at lines 142-145. The spec pseudocode has 'if utilization > 200: return 12, false' as a distinct step that forces SF to constant 12, not an SF increment. Changed the code to: (1) apply ema_loss > 0.25 increment separately, then (2) check utilization > 200 and return (12, False) as required by spec. Verified with test cases.
